title: "A Pilot Study to Determine the Safety of Campath-1H (Anti-CD52) Therapy in Primary Renal Allograft Transplantation"
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to see if campath-1H can be used in first time renal transplant subjects to prevent rejection and reduce the overall amount of anti-rejection medications that patients take on a daily basis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* primary renal transplant (not HLA identical)
* ages 18-60 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* recipient panel reactive antibody level \>10%
* recipient of a DCD kidney
* no prior organ transplant
* no multi-organ transplant recipient
* no subject who is currently receiving systemic corticosteroids
* no pregnant or lactating subjects
* no history of Hepatitis B, C or HIV positivity
* no recipient of a kidney with cold ischemia time \>36 hours
